Overview This CVE describes a sandbox-escape flaw in Pallets Jinja (Jinja2) up to version 2.10.0, exploited through the str.format_map path. If untrusted input is rendered with an enabled or misused sandbox, an attacker could bypass protections and interact with restricted objects in the Python runtime. Upgrading to Jinja2 2.10.1 or newer mitigates the vulnerability. Organizations relying on template rendering should audit their dependency trees and apply updates across all containers and deployment environments to prevent exploitation. Remediation Upgrade Jinja2 to 2.10.1 or newer in all environments (applications, containers, and OS/package-managed installations). Rebuild and redeploy all affected container images and services to include the patched Jinja2 version. Verify the upgrade by checking package versions (e.g., pip show Jinja2) and ensure no transitive dependencies still pull in older Jinja2 versions. Run regression and security tests focused on template rendering to ensure compatibility and that sandbox-related code paths are not exposed to untrusted input. Implement a monitoring/scanning step for future deployments to catch older Jinja2 versions (e.g., integrate a dependency check in CI/CD and container image scans). If upgrading is temporarily not feasible, apply vendor-approved patches or mitigations and limit use of untrusted templates; prioritize upgrading as a must-do.
